$comment: SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later. Expected I/O worked out from OpenRGB's C++ (commit d4798c120659ec5ba2e664a9e87bedff8d36f880, Controllers/LogitechController/LogitechG815Controller and LogitechG915Controller) by a separate reference model that mirrors DeviceUpdateLEDs / SendDirectFrame / SendCommit / SendSingleLed buffer by buffer (openrgb-work/batch2/logitech/gen_kb_fixtures.py in the porting session's scratch space, not part of the repository); plugin.js was never run to make them. Deliberate HueDeck deviations modelled here, as docs/hardware/logitech-keyboard.md describes: InitializeDirect()'s 0x4522 and 0x8071 writes are not sent; the G815's last partial little frame keeps its last blue byte and is zero after the 0xFF end byte; replies are read with a 300 ms timeout. ops: write = output report, read = input report read (len, timeout). Colours are listed per LED in OpenRGB's LED order; 'pos' is the LED's grid cell. Shutdown sets every LED black.
